title: bistorta vivipara var. roessleri
intro: Bistorta vivipara var. roessleri, commonly known as the Rosel's bistort, is a plant species that is a variant of the Bistorta vivipara plant. It is known for its edible rhizome and has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The Rosel's bistort has been reported to have health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is used to treat various health issues such as digestive problems and wounds. The bioactive constituents of the Rosel's bistort include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
